title: Protocol for the generation of pancreatic and hepatic progenitors from human pluripotent stem cells for gene regulatory assays
protocol: Retrieve hPSCs cultured in a 100 mm tissue culture dish.
Observe hPSCs under the microscope.
Aspirate the hPSC culture medium.
Wash cells once with 3 mL of DPBS.
Aspirate the DPBS.
Add 1 mL of ReLeSR™ to the hPSCs.
Incubate at 15°C–25°C for 45 seconds.
Aspirate the ReLeSR™.
Place the cell culture dish into a 37°C humidified incubator for an additional 2.5 minutes.
Gently wash the plate once with 1 mL of DPBS by dispensing slowly at the side of the plate without dislodging the cells.
Aspirate the DPBS.
Add 3 mL of TeSR™-E8™ or mTeSR™1 medium to the plate.
Firmly tap the side of the plate to dislodge the cells.
Transfer detached cell aggregates to a 15 ml tube.
Rinse remaining cells on the plate with 3 mL of TeSR™-E8™ or mTeSR™1 medium.
Transfer rinsed cells to a 15 mL tube.
Top up cell mixture in the tube with 3 mL of TeSR™-E8™ or mTeSR™1 medium.
Pipette up and down once using a 5 mL serological pipette.
Seed 1.5 mL of cell mixture in each well of a coated 6-well plate.
Rock the plate back and forth to ensure even distribution of cells in the wells.
Incubate cells at 37°C, 5% CO2 humidified incubator for two days.
Retrieve hPSCs cultured in a 100 mm tissue culture dish.
Observe hPSCs under the microscope.
Aspirate the hPSC culture medium.
Wash cells once with 3 mL of DPBS.
Aspirate the DPBS.
Add 3 mL of warmed dispase/collagenase (1:1) solution to cover the surface of the entire plate.
Incubate the cells for 3 min at 37°C.
Remove the dispase/collagenase solution.
Wash the cells gently with 3 mL DPBS.
Aspirate the DPBS.
Add 3 mL of hPSC culture medium to the cells.
Scrape cells off the plate mechanically from left to right, up to down, in a horizontal and vertical straight-line fashion until the entire area is scraped.
Collect dissociated cell clusters into a 15 mL tube.
Rinse the remaining cells on the plate with another 3 mL of hPSC medium.
Transfer the rinsed cells to the same 15 mL tube.
Pass harvested cell clusters through an inverted 70 μm cell strainer.
Insert the cell strainer into a 50 mL tube and rinse with 9 mL fresh mTeSR™1 medium.
Gently resuspend the cell mixture using a serological pipette.
Seed 1.5 mL of cells into each well of a coated 6-well plate.
Rock the plate back and forth to ensure even distribution of cells in the wells.
Incubate cells in a 37°C, 5% CO2 humidified incubator for two days.
Do not change the culture medium during the two days of recovery.
Aspirate the hPSC culture medium from the wells.
Replace with 1 mL of RPMI/2% B27 differentiation medium containing 2 μL of 50 ng/μL Activin A, 1 μL of 3 mM CHIR99021, and 1 μL of 10 mM LY294002 per well.
Aspirate old differentiation medium from the wells on day 3.
Replace with 1 mL of RPMMI/2% B27 differentiation medium containing 1 μL of 50 ng/μL Activin A per well.
Aspirate old differentiation medium from the wells on day 5.
Replace with 1 mL of RPMI/2% B27 differentiation medium containing 0.5 μL of 100 ng/μL FGF2, 0.3 μL of 10 mM RA, and 10 μL of 1 M Nicotinamide per well.
Repeat the previous step on day 7.
Aspirate old differentiation medium from the wells on day 10.
Replace with 1 mL of RPMI/2% B27 differentiation medium containing 0.5 μL of 100 ng/μL FGF2, 0.3 μL of 10 mM RA, 10 μL of 1 M Nicotinamide, and 1 μL of 20 mM DAPT per well.
Repeat the previous step on day 13.
Aspirate old differentiation medium from the wells on day 0.
Replace with 1 mL of RPMI/2% B27 differentiation medium containing 2 μL of 50 ng/μL Activin A, 1 μL of 3 mM CHIR99021, and 1 μL of 10 mM LY294002 per well.
Aspirate old differentiation medium from the wells on day 3.
Replace with 1 mL of RPMI/2% B27 differentiation medium containing 1 μL of 50 ng/μL Activin A per well.
Repeat the previous step on day 5.
Aspirate old differentiation medium from the wells on day 6 and replace with 1 mL of RPMI/2% B27 differentiation medium containing 0.4 μL of 50 ng/μL BMP4 and 0.1 μL of 100 ng/μL FGF10 per well.
Repeat the previous step on days 7 and 9.
Aspirate old differentiation medium from the wells on day 10 and replace with 1 mL of hepatocyte basal medium containing 1 μL of 30 ng/μL OSM and 1 μL of 50 ng/μL HGF per well.
Repeat the previous step every alternate day starting from day 12 onwards.
On day 25, hepatocyte-like cells are ready for harvesting.
Collect hPSC-derived cells at an appropriate time point.
Aspirate differentiation medium from the wells and wash cells once with DPBS.
Add 0.5 mL of TrypLE to each well of a 6-well plate and incubate at 37°C for 3–4 min.
Rinse each well with additional 1 mL of basal differentiation medium.
Transfer the remaining cells to a 50 mL tube.
Centrifuge cells at 280 g for 3 min.
Resuspend cells in an appropriate volume of freshly-prepared differentiation medium.
Count the cells and seed 300,000 cells in each well of a 24-well plate.
Culture cells in the incubator for 24 h to allow for cell attachment and recovery.
Replace the media with 250 μL per well of freshly-prepared differentiation medium containing growth factors and small molecules as needed.
Prepare DNA by adding appropriate amounts according to the protocol for each condition.
Mix 4 μl of FuGENE® 6 Transfection reagent with 46 μl of Opti-MEM Reduced Serum Medium.
Add prepared DNA mix to the transfection mix, flick to mix, and let stand for 15 minutes at room temperature (15°C–25°C).
Gently add the DNA-transfection mix dropwise to each well containing cells.
Harvest cells for the luciferase assay 48 hours or 72 hours after transfection as required.
Dilute an appropriate amount of 5× Passive Lysis Buffer with four volumes of distilled water depending on the number of samples needed.
Prepare 100 μl of 1× PLB for each well in a 24-well plate.
Mix sufficient volume of 1× PLB to cover all wells as indicated by the experimental design.
Reconstitute LAR II according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
Reconstitute Stop & Glo reagents according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
Aspirate differentiation medium from wells.
Wash cells once with 250 μL of DPBS per well.
Aspirate the DPBS.
Add 100 μl of PLB per well of a 24-well plate.
Gently rock the plate for 15–20 min at 15°C–25°C to facilitate passive cell lysis.
Centrifuge plate at 195 g for 3 min at 4°C to collect the cell debris at the bottom of the plate.
Transfer 20 μl of the clear supernatant into each well of a flat-bottomed, white 96-well assay plate.
Dispense 100 μl of LAR II to each well using a multi-channel pipette or an appropriate automated injector system.
Measure firefly luciferase activity immediately using a suitable luminescence microplate reader.
Dispense 100 μl of 1× Stop & Glo solution to each well using a multi-channel pipette or an appropriate automated injector system.
Measure Renilla luciferase activity immediately using a suitable luminescence microplate reader.
Subtract background luminescence detected in a non-transfected control sample from all firefly or Renilla luciferase activity results.
Divide luciferase reporter activity by the respective Renilla luciferase activity for each sample to obtain normalized luciferase activity data.
Ensure that LAR II and Stop & Glo reagents are protected from light.
